rows.label: Transformer loading (share of nameplate MVA / kVA)

limits.basis: Duplicated transformers (TX-1 / TX-2, the distribution pair of a stream): each must stay at or below 50 % for the other to carry the whole load, so above 50 % redundancy is already used (warn); alarm at the nameplate rating (100 %). The engine's N-1 loading (hv_tx_load_pct_n1 72.7 %, dist_tx_load_pct_contingency 96.9 % at design load) is what an operator switching in the simulation reaches. No clause read: ASSUMED.
2N: above 50 % one side could not carry the other's load on a transfer (alarm = redundancy lost); warn 5 points before it.

Page band migrated as typed (warn outside 20–80 % RH). The 2015 ASHRAE envelope is dew-point based (A1 allowable 8–80 % RH, recommended to 60 % RH); the page's RH-only band is kept until a dew-point point exists.
ASHRAE 2015 Thermal Guidelines: recommended 18–27 °C (all classes) = normal band; Class A1 allowable 15–32 °C = alarm bounds. Same values the page typed.

source.section: Table 2: Recommended A1–A4 18 to 27 °C; Allowable A1 15 to 32 °C

limits.basis: Warning at or below 80 % (the page's TANK_LOW_PCT, where make-up supply engages), alarm at or below 60 % (TANK_LL_PCT low-low): migrated as typed. A local alarm philosophy, no NFPA 22 clause read: ASSUMED.

Low side from the fire mimic: duty fire pump FP-1 starts at 10.5 bar (warn below it: the main is no longer held by the jockey 11.5/12.8 bar), low-pressure alarm at 8.5 bar. High side ASSUMED (PN16 pipework: warn 14, alarm 16 bar). NFPA 20 clauses not read: ASSUMED.
The fuel mimic's day-tank basis (FU-M-101): lead pump refills at DT_LOW 30 % (warn below it), low-low interlock at DT_LOWLOW 25 % (alarm). DT_HIGH 90 % is the pump stop setpoint, not a limit.

nominal.ref: midpoint of the refill cycle DT_LOW 30 … DT_HIGH 90
